title.narrative: Perceived capabilities of elected leaders by themselves & citizens & ability to drive citizens agenda

description.narrative: Perception of elected leaders themselves and citizens that they will be able to accomplish their promises to the citizens

comment.narrative: Perception of ineffective leaders with low abilities to drive citizens development agenda
Effective leaders based on community perception driving citizens development agenda

The elected leaders were taken through trainings and mentorship sessions and through their regular engagement with the local communities to understand their needs community members feel that they understnd their coommunities needs and have the capacities to address them.

title.narrative: To contribute to strengthened CSOs for enhanced democratic and inclusive electoral processes and more accountable leadership in Tanzania during and after the 2020 general elections.

description.narrative: The aim is to strengthen local CSOs in Tanzania (Tanga, Arusha and Mwanza) regions to agitate for more inclusive electoral process where women and youth participation is a reality and also the leaders are accountable to general citizenry

title.narrative: Perceived levels of inclusivity & transparency for national elections

description.narrative: This refers to how the general public perceives electoral processes in terms of being transparent

comment.narrative: General perception was that elections were never free and fair and never inclusive for women and youth

From the feedback received after the elections champions felt that there was improvement of inclusivity. This will be reviewed after NEC releases the election report. However the 13 CSOs identified being strengthened under the action will improve the situation more
